chunks: So shall We make the later ones to follow them.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He will make the later ones follow the earlier ones in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse highlights the cumulative nature of divine retribution, where later generations of disbelievers are made to follow the path of their predecessors, emphasizing collective accountability. Shia exegetes often view this as a manifestation of God's justice, where the sins of the ancestors do not absolve the descendants but rather compound the weight of their own disbelief. This succession underscores the continuity of the 'state' of misguidance across generations until the final judgment.
